tasks.name: Community post
tasks.notes: 1-2/day SAFE. Text posts from the content pipeline (polls, questions, facts).

tasks.name: Upload Short
tasks.notes: Uploads a REAL film Short if a rendered .mp4 was dropped into the media cache (Film Share card / !film upload); otherwise posts the script as a community text post — honestly labeled.

tasks.name: Engage (watch + like + comment)
tasks.notes: 2h gap. Searches a topic, watches, likes, comments from the pipeline. The one task covers like/comment/watch — separate like/comment tasks were never real.
